Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring special purpose districts and municipalities to post certain information on their web sites.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to posting information on public agencies' websites; and adding a new section to chapter 42.30 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 42.30 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The agenda of all regular and special meetings of the governingbody of every special purpose district and any municipality that ownsor maintains a web site shall be posted within a reasonable time beforea meeting. The text of any ordinance, rule, or regulation that isunder consideration at the meeting shall be included on the web site atthe same time the agenda is posted. The minutes of all regular andspecial meetings of the governing body of every special purposedistrict and any municipality that owns or maintains a web site shallbe posted within a reasonable time after a meeting. (2) Every special purpose district and any municipality that ownsor maintains a public internet web site shall post to it a schedule ofthe time and place of all regular meetings of the governing body.Except in cases of emergency, the special purpose district or p. 1 SB 5672municipality shall promptly post to its web site a notice of the timeand place of all special meetings of the governing body. (3) This section shall not be construed to affect existing publicagency notice requirements in RCW 42.30.060 or 42.30.075.
